output.Title: Domain Names - Implementation and Specification
output.Abstract: This document specifies the data structures and an implementation of the domain system, along with the protocol that is used to access these data structures.

1.Title: Introduction
1.Content: This document specifies the data structures and an implementation of the domain system, along with the protocol that is used to access these data structures.

2.Title: Terminology
2.Content: Defines terms such as 'domain name', 'resource record', 'zone', 'master server', 'slave server', etc.

3.Title: Data Structures
3.Content: Describes the data structures used in the domain system, including SOA records, NS records, and various resource records like A, MX, and TXT.

4.Title: Resource Records
4.Content: Details the types of resource records supported by the DNS, such as A, MX, TXT, PTR, etc., along with their formats and purposes.

5.Title: In-memory Representation
5.Content: Discusses how domain data is represented in memory, including caching strategies and master-slave server relationships.

6.Title: Name Server Software
6.Content: Outlines the requirements and general design for name server software.

7.Title: Stub Resolvers
7.Content: Explains the role of stub resolvers, which are typically found in workstations, in resolving domain names.

8.Title: Query Format
8.Content: Details the format of DNS queries, including query types (QTYPE), class (QCLASS), and other parameters.

9.Title: Resolver Algorithm
9.Content: Describes the algorithm that resolvers use to query name servers and obtain domain information.

10.Title: Data Changes Over Time
10.Content: Discusses how data in the DNS can change over time, including caching and refreshing mechanisms.

11.Title: Transport Issues
11.Content: Addresses transport layer considerations, particularly the use of UDP for DNS queries and responses.

12.Title: Security Considerations
12.Content: Discusses security issues related to the domain system, including potential vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.

13.Title: Application Issues
13.Content: Examines how applications can interface with the DNS for name resolution.
